items.title: KillSec Ransomware Hits Brazilian Healthcare Software Provider

items.title: FBI Warns of Threat Actors Hitting Salesforce Customers
items.description: The FBI's IC3 recently warned of two threat actors, UNC6040 and UNC6395, targeting Salesforce customers, separately and in tandem.

items.title: Mustang Panda Deploys SnakeDisk USB Worm to Deliver Yokai Backdoor on Thailand IPs
items.description: The China-aligned threat actor known as Mustang Panda has been observed using an updated version of a backdoor called TONESHELL and a previously undocumented USB worm called SnakeDisk. "The worm only executes on devices with Thailand-based IP addresses and drops the Yokai backdoor," IBM X-Force researchers Golo Mühr and Joshua Chung said in an analysis published last week. items.title: Zero Trust Is 15 Years Old — Why Full Adoption Is Worth the Struggle
items.description: Fifteen years after its debut, Zero Trust remains the gold standard in cybersecurity theory — but its uneven implementation leaves organizations both stronger and dangerously exposed.
